primary_time_outcome.definition: Complete parent monotonic elapsed seconds from before child admission/setup through terminal cleanup, source/input guard, artifact seal and saved parent receipt. Use identical frozen timer boundaries in all six arms.
primary_time_outcome.pair_delta: delta_i = parent_seconds_OFF_i - parent_seconds_ON_i for fixed anchor i; positive means ON completed sooner.
positive_descriptive_time_label_requires: All six complete within original declared caps, source/data/key/scope/numerical/CSV/ownership parity valid, final audit qualified.
delta_class_trial00 + delta_class_trial01 + delta_reg_trial00 >0; regression no-hit overhead is included.
primary_time_outcome.otherwise: Report measured deltas and no observed net time benefit (or incomplete/null). No stable/general/full-agent gain inference from this small fixed matrix.

positive_mechanism_pass_requires: At least one independently verified eligible same-leaf cached importance reuse;0hits cannot produce mechanismPASS.

Replay ordered ON requests separately per fresh leaf with the frozen key semantics and LRU4entries/262144conservativebytes. A hit is expected exactly when the complete key has a previously stored cacheable valid importance payload still resident under the original bounds.
Observed hit/miss/bypass/store/eviction sequence and hit count equal that replay; no same-content reuse across worker/view/callback/inner-outer namespaces.
Corresponding OFF/ON full prepared fitting contexts and selected outputs agree; student call/iteration/calibration and artifact parity all pass.
mechanism_minimum_and_replay.future_common_trace_required: Record ordered request key/scope, cacheability/bypass, store eligibility/result, payload conservative byte count, post-request resident key digests/LRU order or enough bounded metadata to reproduce eviction, importance/column digest and source-miss reference. Compact metadata only; no raw fitting values/targets/models. Trace overhead included identically or truthfully charged to ON when cache-specific; common input probe remains identical both arms.
mechanism_minimum_and_replay.no_hit: If no eligible repeated key occurs or all requests legitimately bypass, conclude no eligible reuse/inconclusive, notPASS or a savings claim; continue the originally fixed matrix per r2.
mechanism_minimum_and_replay.missed_or_false_reuse: An eligible resident repeat missed, a nonresident/cross-scope false hit, invalid store or inconsistent trace rejects the mechanism, even if predictions happen to match.
